name: Water Dungeon
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one NEW Water Dungeon mobile battle-page background in this exact game's illustrated style. Input 1 is the approved cave background: match its quiet composition, large simple forms, soft contrast and outline treatment. Input 2 is a style reference for the game's chunky clean silhouettes; do not copy its gate. STYLE: Match the supplied game art: clean chunky cartoon illustration, simple broad 2-3 tone cel-shaded shapes, confident muted dark-plum contours on edge objects, no photorealism, fine texture, tiny cracks, grain, 3D rendering, excessive gradients or intricate details. Theme palette: dusty teal, slate blue, sea-glass cyan and cool gray.
SCENE: A quiet tidal grotto with smooth blue-gray stone walls and a few broad shell-like stone forms at the far edges. A few subdued turquoise facets are embedded in the side walls. Keep the broad central floor DRY blue-gray stone; small dark water recesses may appear only at the very bottom outer corners, never through the central floor.
COMPOSITION: 9:20 portrait, 1440 x 3200. The board and UI cover most of the central upper area. Keep the central 76% of the width quiet and mostly featureless; put the theme's bold recognizable details at asymmetric extreme sides and corners, with varied shape, height and spacing. Avoid matching rows or repetitive paired clusters. Keep a broad low-contrast floor in the lower half, which matches this board material: pale desaturated blue-gray smooth worn limestone with faint irregular sea-glass teal mottling; sparse tiny flat mineral flecks, no liquid or wet reflections. Board and panels must read clearly. No high-contrast rocks, liquid, branches or objects crossing the central clearing. Keep details visible close enough to the sides for a narrow phone composition, but modest in size. Restrained gentle dark-plum outline weights like input 1; clean bold outer contours on side objects. No board, grid lines, purple divider, baked frame, rounded-corner mask, icons, characters, text or labels. Full bleed opaque image. Output only ONE finished background, no collage or comparison.
